summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The iShares Russell Top 200 Value ETF (IWX) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Russell Top 200 Value index. The fund tracks an index of large-cap stocks selected from 200 of the largest US value companies. IWX was launched on Sep 22, 2009 and is issued by BlackRock.

holdings.infoBox: IWX is an equity ETF with a total of 156 individual holdings. The top holdings are Apple stock at 8.39%, Amazon.com at 8.19%, Microsoft at 7.08%, Berkshire Hathaway at 3.51%, and JPMorgan Chase & Co. at 3.37%.
